releases.name: Agent Console 1.3.1
releases.body:
Sync with `@magpie-community/page-agent-console` 1.3.1 ([magpie-community/plugins#733](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/pull/733) and [#747](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/pull/747), merge commits 5703c9f and 2c4e76d).

- **Windows**: automatically finds Git Bash instead of the WSL `bash` launcher; raw process output stays UTF-8 or falls back to the system ANSI code page (GBK on Chinese Windows).
- **Timeline**: compact tool-step rows, with longer runs folded into an expandable summary; clearer code blocks and task progress.
- **Sleep / wake recovery**: the stable port 3488 wrapper detects a lost daemon and restores the console after sleep or a daemon restart.
- **Composer**: messages appear immediately on send, with retry / remove on failure; select reply text to quote it in the composer.
- **Auto-approve all**: an opt-in permission mode, off by default, with a persistent indicator and a saved approval trace. Plan approvals and questions still ask; Pi keeps its own mode so switching Agents does not silently enable auto-approval there.

npm: `magpie-agent-console@1.3.1`

releases.name: Agent Console 1.2.0
releases.body:
Sync with `@magpie-community/page-agent-console` 1.2.0 (magpie-community/plugins#582, merge commit 270b228).

- **Preview tab**: a small browser in the right panel for local dev servers, loaded through the daemon's loopback preview proxy (module scripts, `fetch`, HMR work inside Magpie's sandboxed frame).
- **Links in chat**: local addresses open in the Preview tab; other http(s) links open the system browser.
- **File chips**: drag a Files row into the composer (or right-click → Add to chat) to send checked project-relative paths.
- **Layout settings**: content width and chat font size; sidebar toggle (Ctrl/⌘+B).
- **Live theme**: light/dark, Magpie's neutral colours and language follow Magpie while the page is open.
- **Security fixes** from the #582 review: preview proxy answers only at a per-listener keyed `ac<key>.localhost` host, per-open ping nonce, keyless canary, Magpie gateway/gate/daemon ports refused, WebKit before macOS 26 fails closed; `openExternal` is http/https only via `execFile` with no shell; file mentions checked inside the project.

npm: `magpie-agent-console@1.2.0`
